description:
**KFT's §3.1 modality enum has five rows and no audio, and a downstream product has been waiting on the two that are missing.**

`registry/enums/modality.tsv` carries `text-generation`, `image-text-to-text`, `video-text-to-text`, `text-to-image`, `text-to-video`. There is no `text-to-audio` and no `audio-to-audio` — `grep -rn 'text-to-audio\|audio-to-audio'` across the whole of koine returns **0 hits**.

**formant cannot finish `38-kft-generative-audio-ratify-and-flip` until they exist.** That tasklist's acceptance criteria require its `KftModality` to be *"a verbatim mirror of the ratified koine enum"*, and a verbatim mirror of an enum that lacks your rows is not something an agent can honestly write. It ran five iterations, verified the enum four separate ways, and correctly refused to fake it. An 18-repo audit on 2026-08-25 recorded `38` as parked on koine and never checked whether the koine side had an owner. **It did not.**

**It was also released prematurely.** `38` declared `dependsOn: koine:69-kft-open-questions`; `69` merged at `e8f5d85`, folding a §11 open question into `specs/fine-tuning.md` — worthwhile, and it never touched the modality enum. So the dependency was satisfied by adjacent work and `38` was dispatched into a wall. Its edge is being repointed here.

**The generative-audio case is the one KFT's own shape predicts.** The two diffusion rows already there — `text-to-image` and `text-to-video` — are `media(image)` / `media(video)` planes taking a caption and producing an asset. Audio is the third medium of that family and KMI already carries `audio/*` in its media types, so the plane exists; only the modality rows are absent.

**`audio-to-audio` is the row that needs thought.** It is not a caption-to-asset shape — it is transformation, closer to a filter than a generator, and its data plane and typical method may not follow the diffusion rows. Decide it deliberately rather than by symmetry with `text-to-audio`, and if it does not belong in this enum, say so and land only the row that does.

userStories.title: Decide which audio modalities the contract carries
acceptanceCriteria: `text-to-audio` is specified against the same axes the existing rows use — data planes, typical base, typical method, description — following the `text-to-image` / `text-to-video` diffusion pattern it belongs to.

`audio-to-audio` gets a DECIDED verdict, not an assumed one. It is a transformation rather than a caption-to-asset generation, so its planes and methods may not mirror the diffusion rows; if it does not belong in this enum, record why and land only `text-to-audio`.
The decision names which media plane carries the training assets. KMI already lists `audio/*` in its media types, so verify the plane exists as described rather than asserting it.

A modality nobody can currently train is still worth contracting IF a downstream provider is waiting on the vocabulary — say which providers these rows are for, so a later reader knows whether an unimplemented row was an oversight or a deliberate forward declaration.
userStories.notes: DECIDED: both rows land. text-to-audio = media(audio) / Stable Audio Open, MusicGen, AudioLDM 2 / lora|full, the third diffusion row. audio-to-audio ADMITTED on a stated-and-answered case against it (enum is not generation-only — 3 of 5 rows are understanding modalities; KMI §6 types an invocation, KFT §3.1 types a training target; excluding it forces FT-F to validate a false declaration). It lands on its OWN axes: same media(audio) plane but paired asset↔asset with no caption side, typical_base is small task-specific architectures (RVC, so-vits-svc, Demucs) not foundation models, so typical_method is full|lora with full LEADING. Media plane VERIFIED in 4 places in KMI, not asserted: §2 media_type is IANA, §2 probe carries kind:audio, §6's own worked port example is media_types:[audio/wav], §8 lists an Audio-producer role. Correction recorded: registry/media-types.tsv does NOT list audio/* and correctly so — it registers only koine-MINTED vendor types; the tasklist framing was loose. Checked §4.2 rather than assuming: both sides of a pair are dataset.media[] entries so the most-restrictive union already covers them — no §4 clause moves. Providers named from ECOSYSTEM §2: formant (audio-plugin/instrument IDE — both rows, blocked on them for its verbatim KftModality mirror), lugh (audio-to-audio especially — user recordings classify personal/local-only, which §4.2 routes to local compute i.e. to lugh), agora (both, as the all-exportable case). Deliberate non-mints recorded with triggers: no text-to-speech split, no audio-text-to-text, no audio plane, no media-types.tsv row. Record: docs/reference/generative-audio-modalities.md, linked from docs/README.md (that index states 'a document not linked here does not exist'). No spec/registry/schema file touched — US-2 lands the rows. ALSO FIXED pre-existing merge blocker: commit c6cae87 retired tasklist 86 into tasks/chief/completed/ without repointing 6 docs, leaving 7 dead links; guard-doc-integrity is a wall, so the branch could not have merged. GATES ALL GREEN: doc-integrity OK (55 files, 1308 links, 3 status tables match headers, 7 errors -> 0); doc-links 0 dead vs 2 on main (retired 2); registry OK (29 relations, modality 5 rows unchanged); schemas OK (9 schemas, 278 positions, 80 $refs, 3 fixtures); tasklist-categories OK; verify-test 30 passed, 0 failed.

userStories.title: The rows land in every place the enum is stated
acceptanceCriteria: `registry/enums/modality.tsv` gains the decided row(s), matching the existing column shape exactly.

`specs/fine-tuning.md` §3.1 and `schemas/finetune-job.schema.json`'s `properties.modality.enum` agree with the registry. Three statements of one vocabulary that can disagree is the drift this repo's own gates exist to catch — verify all three, do not assume the schema follows the TSV.
The spec version is bumped and Status reconsidered against the ladder. KFT is at 0.6.0 Candidate; a normative vocabulary change re-enters validation rather than riding the existing status.
A changelog entry records what was added and, if `audio-to-audio` was declined, that decision too.
userStories.notes: LANDED at KFT 0.7.0 in all FOUR statements of the vocabulary, not three. registry/enums/modality.tsv +2 rows (5-column shape held, awk field count = 5 on every line); specs/fine-tuning.md §3.1 table +2 rows; schemas/finetune-job.schema.json properties.modality.enum; and registry/README.md's prose bullet — the fourth statement, which NO guard checks (now says so in its own text). VERIFIED MECHANICALLY, not by eye: a script parsed all four surfaces and asserted list equality including order — 7 tokens each, ALL FOUR IDENTICAL AND IN ORDER: True. The schema was not assumed to follow the TSV. VERSION 0.6.0 -> 0.7.0, MINOR: §3.1's table is normative surface a reader implements against and FT-F validates from, so two new admissible tokens widen what a conformant provider must recognise (a token it does not know is a refusal). STATUS stays Candidate — a normative vocabulary change re-enters validation. GATES: both standing gates restated, NEITHER moved, and NO third gate — a token cannot break a manifest that does not name it, and FT-F's mechanism is byte-unchanged. Instead the two tokens are recorded in *Pressure test* as UNEXERCISED VOCABULARY, the precedent being how §3.3/§8.1 are already recorded; noted that the multimodal pass's 'audio LoRA (text-to-image-style)' stressor is the exact coinage these rows exist to make unnecessary and so is not evidence for them. CHANGELOG entry records both additions and the audio-to-audio adjudication (case against stated and answered three ways), why TTS rides text-to-audio rather than a sixth row, that the media(audio) plane was verified in four places in KMI rather than asserted, and that no clause of §4 moves. MIRRORS: README.md, specs/README.md (status table + the unguarded prose list), ECOSYSTEM.md §2 — all three diffed by check-doc-integrity and confirmed matching — plus CLAUDE.md *Current state* and ROADMAP.md's re-ratification row, neither guarded, both updated by hand and read back. Golden fixture kft_version 0.6.0 -> 0.7.0 (git history confirms it tracks the spec on every fold). No registry/media-types.tsv row: audio/wav is IANA's, per US-1's correction. GATES ALL GREEN: doc-integrity OK (55 files, 1316 links, 3 status tables match headers, fine-tuning reads 0.7.0 candidate); doc-links 0 dead vs 2 on main; registry OK (modality.tsv 7 rows, 29 relation names); schemas OK (9 schemas, 278 positions, 80 $refs, 3 fixtures); tasklist-categories OK; verify-test 30 passed, 0 failed.

userStories.title: The downstream mirrors are told, not left to discover it
acceptanceCriteria: The consumers of this enum are named — formant's `KftModality`, lugh's narrow-provider envelope, agora's general trainer — with what each must do to pick the rows up.
Report, do not edit. These live in other repos and koine specifies rather than implements; the deliverable is a statement each repo's own tasklist can act on.

Flag the version drift found alongside this: formant's `KFT_VERSION` reads `0.3.0` against this spec's 0.6.0. That is a separate defect in a separate repo and it is exactly the kind of thing a vocabulary change makes worse, so it should be visible before these rows land.
userStories.notes: REPORT DELIVERED, nothing outside the worktree written or read (ADR-0001: koine specifies). docs/reference/generative-audio-modalities-downstream.md (new) names all three consumers with an action each, as citable findings AUD-1...AUD-6 so a sibling tasklist lifts a row instead of paraphrasing prose. formant AUD-1: KftModality re-vendors from registry/enums/modality.tsv (the ONE of koine's four statements to mirror -- the spec table has no description column, the registry README bullet is unguarded), all 7 tokens IN FILE ORDER at KFT 0.7.0; its five-iteration refusal to fake the mirror was correct and is now unblocked. AUD-2 (found while writing, not commissioned): tasklist 38 requires a mirror of the RATIFIED enum and KFT is 0.7.0 CANDIDATE on two unmoved gates, so read literally 38 is still blocked -- resolution is formant's (restate as 'published at 0.7.0'), koine does not promote a spec to unblock a mirror. AUD-3 = the flagged drift: KFT_VERSION 0.3.0 (reported) vs 0.7.0, four minors behind (0.4.0 intake / 0.5.0 conversion+refusal / 0.6.0 resume / 0.7.0 audio); why a vocabulary change makes it WORSE stated concretely -- after AUD-1 the mirror carries tokens that exist only at 0.7.0 while the pin claims 0.3.0, and kft_version travels on the wire. lugh AUD-4: the koine-internal chain verified link by link (personal recordings -> KGP 7.1/7.2 local-only -> KFT 4.2 most-restrictive union -> 4.2 placement -> in-tier compute), so a token lugh does not know collapses out-of-envelope (re-routable) into invalid (terminal), and 8.1's no-breach rule then makes an EMPTY route_to[] the correct answer; also KFT 2's own manifest already lists audio/* so no new field/port/plane, but widening a narrower port moves its schema_id -> KCB 7.2 minor bump required (KCB 7.2's table rules a widened input port minor and non-breaking). agora AUD-5: re-vendor finetune-job.schema.json -- a validator still on the 0.6.0 enum rejects a CONFORMANT 0.7.0 job as invalid, the one place a lag yields a wrong answer rather than a missing capability. AUD-6: no scenario walks an audio job, so no KCS encoding can assert one and neither row is citable in a re-ratification; that scenario + encoding are UNOWNED, like DR-11...DR-13. Provenance kept in two classes throughout: koine claims cited by file+section, sibling-repo claims marked (reported) and attributed to the commissioning tasklist. Indexed in docs/README.md (the hard index), linked from the decision page 5, and recorded as a cross-repo obligation row in ROADMAP Phase F3. GATES ALL GREEN: doc-integrity OK (56 files, 1332 links, all 3 status tables match headers, fine-tuning 0.7.0 candidate; 3 self-inflicted errors caught and fixed -- one wrong-depth ADR path and two anchor slugs, GitHub collapses the em-dash double space to a single dash); doc-links 0 dead vs 2 on main; registry OK (modality.tsv 7 rows, 29 relation names); schemas OK (9 schemas, 278 positions, 80 $refs, 3 fixtures); tasklist-categories OK; verify-test 30 passed, 0 failed.
